extraction_method: reference — full SAR key-term taxonomy decomposed into datasets_v3/sources/typology_registry.json under SAR_ADVISORY_* keys. This extract documents which advisories were selected as relevant to our archetypes (out of ~40 total listed on the FinCEN page).

value.relevance: phone/grandparent/romance scams on elderly remittance senders
gig platforms (worker email compromise), remittance wire redirection
platform accounts (gig), remittance app accounts, ITIN credit-file compromise
earthquake/hurricane-aid scams targeting remittance senders to affected origin countries
ITIN-specific: fraudulent returns filed using ITIN holders' identities
informal value transfer (hawala, informal couriers) — remittance alternative channels
US-Mexico corridor TBML; structured cash deposits used for remittance laundering
wage confiscation in gig work; coerced transfers from trafficking victims
phishing/ransomware — cross-cutting; credential compromise feeding ATO
processor-facilitated unauthorized ACH / chargebacks affecting consumer accounts

selected_advisories_relevant_to_archetyp.source_ref: FinCEN SAR Advisory Key Terms page

advisories_excluded_as_out_of_scope.value: Excluded from v3: North Korea, Iran, ISIS, FATF country-jurisdiction lists, Venezuela / South Sudan / Nicaragua corruption, ransomware-specific advisories for institutional filers, healthcare fraud, real estate fraud, TARP, casino structuring. These don't ground the four archetypes directly.

suitable_for_grounding_fields: family_crisis_history (fraud events tied to specific FinCEN advisories)
persona_grounding_implications.behavioral_evidence_grade_when_used: B — regulatory typology source. Combined with FinCEN FTA 2024, forms the core of the B-grade evidence layer.
